content.value_statement: Teams need fast search that stays relevant as data changes. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical Algolia patterns for implementation.
actual_capabilities: Explains React InstantSearch setup with hooks, widgets, and custom hit rendering.
Shows Next.js server-side rendering patterns for Algolia search pages.
Guides data synchronization with batch indexing, partial updates, and zero-downtime reindexing.
Describes search-only, admin, and secured API key usage with restrictions.
Covers facets, filters, custom ranking, synonyms, rules, and autocomplete suggestions.
limitations: It provides implementation guidance, not a runnable Algolia integration package.
It does not validate live Algolia settings or index schemas automatically.
Examples must be adapted to the project framework, data model, and security policy.
It does not replace Algolia documentation for current product limits or pricing.

use_cases.title: Add Product Search
use_cases.description: Implement a React or Next.js search page with search boxes, hit lists, filters, pagination, and sorting.

use_cases.title: Design Indexing Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan batch indexing, partial updates, delete operations, and full reindexing for changing product or content data.

use_cases.title: Improve Relevance and Security
use_cases.description: Tune searchable attributes, custom ranking, API key restrictions, rate limits, and secured search keys.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Search Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Algolia search skill to outline a React InstantSearch page for products with a search box, results, and pagination.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Index Synchronization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Algolia search skill to design an indexing workflow for my data model, including batch size, partial updates, and deletion strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Secure Search API Keys
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Algolia search skill to review my API key plan and recommend safe frontend, server, and secured key patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Relevance and Autocomplete
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Algolia search skill to propose searchable attributes, custom ranking, facets, synonyms, rules, and autocomplete behavior for my catalog.

output_examples.input: Request: Add search to a product catalog with categories, brands, and price filters.
output_examples.output: A structured implementation plan with React InstantSearch widgets, required index settings, facet attributes, and replica index notes.

output_examples.input: Request: Review Algolia key usage for a public search page and indexing job.
output_examples.output: A security review that separates search-only keys, admin keys, secured keys, referrer limits, rate limits, and server-only usage.

output_examples.input: Request: Improve poor search relevance for products with popularity and ratings.
output_examples.output: A relevance tuning checklist covering searchable attribute order, custom ranking, typo tolerance, synonyms, rules, and analytics review.

best_practices: Keep admin API keys on the server and expose only restricted search keys to clients.
Batch indexing operations and prefer partial updates when only a few attributes change.
Define searchable attributes, facets, and custom ranking before optimizing interface details.
anti_patterns: Do not place admin API keys in frontend code or public environment variables.
Do not reindex the full dataset for small changes that partial updates can handle.
Do not enable facets without declaring the attributes in Algolia index settings.

faq.question: Does this skill install Algolia packages?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and examples that you apply in your own project.

faq.question: Can it help with Next.js search pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for React InstantSearch and Next.js server-side rendering patterns.

faq.question: Does it cover API key safety?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains search-only keys, admin keys, secured keys, referrer restrictions, and rate limits.

faq.question: Can it design indexing jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers batch indexing, partial updates, deletes, and zero-downtime full reindexing.

faq.question: Does it support autocomplete?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for query suggestions, instant results, and autocomplete integration.

faq.question: Should I still check Algolia documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. Use current Algolia documentation for package versions, service limits, and pricing details.
